title: Measure the video editor against Premiere, and file every gap
goal: The user wants video editing here to be better than Premiere, and so far each feature has only been judged on its own. Do a real editing session with default settings, cutting a five minute recording to ninety seconds with a second clip, music, a transition, titles, captions and an MP4 export, and write down every place it is slower, clumsier, missing or uglier than Premiere, with pictures.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): The user's goal for video is to be better than Premiere at editing recordings, and today it is a first pass at each feature, never judged as a whole. Do a real editing session on real recordings in the probe app with no flags forced beyond Next defaults (after the task that turns the editor on lands): cut a 5 minute screen recording down to 90 seconds, split the audio off, add a second clip and a music bed, put a transition on a cut, add titles and captions, punch in on a detail, export MP4. Write down every place it is slower, clumsier, missing or uglier than Premiere Pro (and than Final Cut / ScreenFlow / Screen Studio for screen recordings), with pictures.

User on 2026-09-23: 'I want the video editing with the timeline and the whole goal to be better than premiere and this is the most basic shit possible'. Depends on: a-recording-opens-in-the-video-editor-for-real-in-next.
acceptance: A written gap report in docs/design/video-vs-premiere.md: each gap has what Premiere does, what Photonz does, a picture, and a severity
Every gap that matters is filed as its own p1 task with source user, sequenced by how much it blocks a real edit
A standing objective in queue/objectives.json: better than Premiere at editing screen recordings, with measurable success criteria the manager pass files work against

Basic editing (blade/split at playhead, ripple delete, J/K/L shuttle, drag clips between tracks, add a layer over video, detach audio, snapping, undo) is checked first and anything missing from that list is filed ahead of the polish gaps

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes; epic (none) -> video-editing; depends on a-recording-opens-in-the-video-editor-for-real-i

manager 2026-09-23 06:10: keyframing (Premiere's Effect Controls) is owned by keyframe-anything-and-see-and-shape-the-keys-on and its three slices. If they have not landed when this runs, name the gap and point at them rather than filing it again.

manager 2026-09-24: all five deps are done, so this is claimable. Already filed from the editing-session walk, do not refile: captions not following a cut (cutting-a-stretch-out-of-a-recording-takes-its-c), export size estimate 14x high (the-export-sheet-s-size-for-an-edited-video-is-c), no way to save an edit (a-video-edit-can-be-saved-as-a-project-and-opene), sound hard-cutting at a transition (a-transition-carries-the-sound-across-the-cut-to). Also noted and not filed yet: sound is silent while shuttling at 2x or backwards (Premiere plays it pitched).

Adversarial pass before measuring: the brief asks for a real 5 minute recording, but the only samples are 8 s and 17 s, so a 300 s 2880x1800 talking recording was built with say+ffmpeg in /tmp (not committed). Walks cannot hear, so audio gaps (shuttle sound) were not reproduced. A walk 'click' at window coordinates lands in the canvas view, not the SwiftUI timeline, so a first Blade click looked broken; pressing the Blade's own control cut fine. Not a bug.

Walks used (in /tmp/photonz-5min): five-min-walk (keys at open, zoom, S C Q W ' ; Cmd-D N R, I/O + Shift-Delete, 8 s playback, export sheet), five-min-walk-2 (ruler at 4x and deepest zoom, Add Track, music bed drop), five-min-walk-3 (hitch timings with and without captions, Blade control). All three ran green with real captures.

left rough, did not earn a task: no frames in the time readout (0:04 where Premiere shows 00:00:04:12; the playhead readout has 4.31 s); the picture shrinks 35% to 32% as tracks are added (Premiere scrolls the tracks instead); the title bar says Everything where the mock names the document (comes with project saving). Sound silent while shuttling at 2x/backwards was noted by the manager and NOT reproduced here (walks cannot listen), so not filed.
owns no walks; the ones it names are examples
